## Client Config (Keystone)
Reads the client's row from **Airtable > My Clients** (Keystone Client Finder base). Edit settings there, not here.
Matches by clientId, then called phone number, then "the only active client with invoicing on". If no client matches, or it is paused/stopped, this fails safely and the Failure Alert fires.
